goal: Reconcile actual conversation composition and conditional surfaces so users need not discover missing placement or workflow contracts themselves.
scope: Installed T3 conversation subtree and its sibling mount boundaries, compared with Ferrite source and existing audit evidence. No native execution by this worker.
revision_rule: All T3 source links here are installed-SHA links. Newer checkout used for filename discovery only; prior reports may contain explicitly qualified newer citations.

surfaces.name: Main conversation route
surfaces.purpose: Read and operate the selected root conversation.
surfaces.placement: Main SidebarInset content, containing ChatView, not either sidebar.
surfaces.triggers: Select root thread or route directly.
surfaces.coexistence: Header, timeline, composer, independent details card and workspace siblings.
surfaces.responsive: Workspace maximization gives chat w-0 and inert; embedded mode has different chrome.
surfaces.ownership: Scoped environment and thread; draft routes resolve separately.
surfaces.focus: Header menus, composer, Find, workspace have separate focus areas.
surfaces.motion: Panel or draft movement has explicit gates; route change is not proof of transition.
surfaces.lifetime: Thread mount and remembered ready timeline are keyed; displayed and requested data can differ while loading.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Ordinary Pane and TranscriptView.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A right-panel Agent inspector or Overview tab is not the main conversation.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Main transcript covered; composition previously scattered.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: No additional root-feature defect asserted.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native roots exercised.

surfaces.name: Provider child full conversation
surfaces.purpose: Inspect a provider-owned child with its own complete transcript.
surfaces.placement: Normal main conversation route, reached from agent/lineage actions.
surfaces.triggers: onOpenRelatedThread navigates to /$environmentId/$threadId; lineage does likewise unless side chat.
surfaces.coexistence: Parent breadcrumb, transcript, footer and optional workspace; parent draft stays with parent.
surfaces.responsive: Normal reading lane; a narrow optional inspector is a separate product choice.
surfaces.ownership: Selected child projection; provider owns execution and may forbid independent prompting.
surfaces.focus: Open parent returns through scoped navigation; child footer is not an input.
surfaces.motion: No main-child entrance animation is proven by the route source.
surfaces.lifetime: Child route loads its own detail, including omitted idle children.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Full-Pane Subject selection exists, but ordinary row action opens a compact Agent panel.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Widening/maximizing Agent panel alone does not meet the primary main-conversation placement contract.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Live route was recorded but original Unit 12 assumed compact Panel as primary.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Confirmed recommendation/placement omission, corrected by dedicated addendum.
surfaces.native_evidence: Sol and Sonnet child routes and live stdout verified; full nested lifecycle is not universally certified.

surfaces.name: Conversation header and parent breadcrumb
surfaces.purpose: Identify project, parent and selected thread; expose thread actions and Find entry.
surfaces.placement: Header above canvas, suppressed for embedded side chats.
surfaces.triggers: Existing thread/draft and parent link; title activation or context menu.
surfaces.coexistence: Separate from panel toggles and details-card toggle in same title region.
surfaces.responsive: Parent title collapses to fit measured breadcrumb width.
surfaces.ownership: Selected thread/project; parent may belong to another environment.
surfaces.focus: Semantic title button/menu and rename input; breadcrumb can open parent.
surfaces.motion: Hover/title transitions are CSS details, not panel motion.
surfaces.lifetime: Mounted with route header; embedded ChatView omits this header.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Pane title/Subject navigation and menus.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Generic panel title cannot identify full conversation ancestry.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Thread navigation covered; parent/title placement was not a unified contract.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Require breadcrumb and menu destination checks in child and root modes.
surfaces.native_evidence: Parent breadcrumb and Open parent verified; every title/rename variant not certified.

surfaces.name: Virtualized transcript and earlier-history control
surfaces.purpose: Render live answers and retrieve prior turns without losing reading position.
surfaces.placement: Scrollable main lane; earlier-history/error control is its list header.
surfaces.triggers: Projection deltas, route switch, Load earlier, or citation/Find history demand.
surfaces.coexistence: Composer overlay reserves content inset; header and footer can coexist with long history.
surfaces.responsive: Min-width and lane inset come from ChatCanvas measurements; long content must wrap.
surfaces.ownership: Per-thread live turn items; remembered ready transcript excludes ephemeral previews.
surfaces.focus: Focusable earlier-history button; history error/retry are visible rather than silent blank content.
surfaces.motion: Maintain-visible-content positioning and scroll adjustments are separate from appearance animation.
surfaces.lifetime: Ready timeline cache is keyed; earlier pages and work-history loads are independent.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: TranscriptView list with retained rendering window and scroll anchors.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A current rendered window is not proof that earlier persisted history can be loaded.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Source and controlled scroll coverage exist; historical paging runtime remains bounded.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: No newly reproduced defect; retain paging/loading/error contract separately.
surfaces.native_evidence: Rich output and selected navigation verified; all historical paging states not executed.

surfaces.name: Find in thread overlay
surfaces.purpose: Search conversation messages with counts and exact occurrence navigation.
surfaces.placement: Absolute top-right canvas overlay, not a workspace tab or browser Find.
surfaces.triggers: Thread Find command or header action, when server capability permits.
surfaces.coexistence: Reserves details-card top inset; parent PR/tool panel can remain open.
surfaces.responsive: Width is capped by details-card width and available chat width.
surfaces.ownership: Provider owns query/count state below ChatView; server filters message/plan/input candidates.
surfaces.focus: Open/refire focuses and selects input; Enter/Shift-Enter navigate; close callback focuses composer.
surfaces.motion: 150ms opacity entrance with reduced-motion opt-out.
surfaces.lifetime: One scoped Find store; content changes refresh results; history reveal may materialize unloaded rows.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Transcript Find bar searches rendered logical-text projection.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Browser Find, file Find, or a generic panel search is not conversation Find.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Prose Find and Ferrite folded exclusion covered; prior broad T3 tool-search assumption corrected.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Must preserve exact search scope; installed T3 excludes command_execution regardless of fold.
surfaces.native_evidence: AMBER counts/Enter verified; command-only token returned 0/0; not data loss.

surfaces.name: Timeline minimap and previous/next-turn navigation
surfaces.purpose: Show turn positions and move directly among prompts.
surfaces.placement: Beside timeline list, not the left thread sidebar.
surfaces.triggers: Hover/focus navigation buttons or strip activation.
surfaces.coexistence: Find and panel state are independent; selected turn reveals in same conversation.
surfaces.responsive: Gutter tracks actual list viewport and content width.
surfaces.ownership: Derived from current rows, visible range and prompt row indices.
surfaces.focus: Buttons have Previous turn/Next turn labels; no-op/disabled state depends on current range/end.
surfaces.motion: Requested turn scroll uses reduced-motion gate; strip/button hover opacity is separate.
surfaces.lifetime: Current index refreshes from layout and scroll metrics; not a saved chapter system.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Ferrite has a minimap rail, prompt/failure/Decision/pass ticks, viewport band, and click/rail jumps. Equivalent previous/next-turn buttons and full keyboard/focus behavior were not established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Pin as chapter or ordinary scroll is not equivalent to turn overview/navigation.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Motion report already covers minimap snap navigation; native T3 verified one Next turn. Previous reconciliation lacked explicit comparison of the existing rail and adjacent-turn controls.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Detailed destination/focus acceptance gap, not an absent minimap or new Ferrite runtime failure.
surfaces.native_evidence: Next turn reached quote/comment/image turn with PR retained; full minimap interaction untested.

surfaces.name: Work groups, live row and historical folds
surfaces.purpose: Present commands/reasoning and elapsed activity without consuming the entire transcript.
surfaces.placement: Inline work-log rows and bounded expandable history inside timeline.
surfaces.triggers: Running work, disclosure, turn/attempt folds, work-history demand.
surfaces.coexistence: Final prose, pending approval row, working footer and group detail have distinct positions.
surfaces.responsive: Expanded virtual list caps at min(18rem,50dvh) plus opened detail height.
surfaces.ownership: Disclosure and expanded-entry state belong to group; historic turn data can load lazily.
surfaces.focus: Header/row aria-expanded and keyboard disclosure; nested scrolling must remain reachable.
surfaces.motion: Chevron transitions, activity shimmer and append-follow exist; grouping uses selected nonanimated panels.
surfaces.lifetime: Expansion retains entry IDs within group view; loading skeleton and history errors are independent.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Work rows, grouped calls, turn folds and thinking tail.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A tool name or final summary alone does not show current output or full historical details.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Core source and controlled disclosure covered.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Explicit row dispatcher now prevents treating every history form as one generic tool block.
surfaces.native_evidence: Several command disclosures and live output verified; all fold/history states untested.

surfaces.name: Tool item inspector and live output
surfaces.purpose: Inspect actual arguments, stdout, diff, images and structured tool results.
surfaces.placement: Inline WorkLogDetails, not a global tool inspector window.
surfaces.triggers: Expand individual tool entry or fetch retained output.
surfaces.coexistence: Inside bounded group; open diff can hand off to full workspace while transcript stays.
surfaces.responsive: Pre/code content has its own overflow; environment capability gates output subscription.
surfaces.ownership: Thread/item identity keys output; command deltas and final persisted result are distinct sources.
surfaces.focus: Expanded row uses keyboard disclosure; image/diff buttons have separate actions.
surfaces.motion: Chevron/row interactions do not imply streaming transition; stdout subscription is data flow.
surfaces.lifetime: Inspector mounts on expanded entry; live panel follows until user scrolls away and settles to final output.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Expanded tool call rows and native preview/diff destinations.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Background panel with No output yet is wrong when the child transcript contains known output.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Actual live streams covered; some tool-result branches remained source-only.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Keep item inspection distinct from agent full conversation and background roster.
surfaces.native_evidence: Sol parent/child and Sonnet child stdout verified before completion.

surfaces.name: Inline agent group, agent links and hover information
surfaces.purpose: Show related launched agents, aggregate progress and links into each child.
surfaces.placement: Inline work-log group inside parent transcript.
surfaces.triggers: Subagent item; group only when row has more than one agent.
surfaces.coexistence: Lineage card is an additional navigation view, not replacement for these rows.
surfaces.responsive: Group has bounded avatars/count and truncated text with hover details.
surfaces.ownership: Runtime projected subagent identity and status, not independent user thread rows.
surfaces.focus: Collapsible group and child link are distinct targets; hover card does not become editable chat.
surfaces.motion: Opacity/chevron CSS; group panel explicitly animate=false.
surfaces.lifetime: Open child loads own route; group expansion belongs to row state.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Grouped agent rows and progress exist; opener currently routes to compact Panel.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Left-sidebar tree or background card does not satisfy inline launch context plus correct main route.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Group mechanics covered; initial repair direction missed destination size/placement.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Link group must be reconciled with corrected main-child action, not merely retain clickable pills.
surfaces.native_evidence: Real children and prior-agent movement verified; all hover states not native certified.

surfaces.name: Independent Thread details card
surfaces.purpose: Keep compact execution and thread context available beside conversation.
surfaces.placement: Absolute upper-right aside, or dedicated anchored popover when space is insufficient.
surfaces.triggers: Independent toggle/shortcut; per-thread presentation state.
surfaces.coexistence: Separate from full workspace; card layout avoids Find and preview/composer footprints.
surfaces.responsive: 280px source card with density full/compact/essential; placement fallback is measured, not a freely dragged window.
surfaces.ownership: Scoped environment/thread and independent inline/popover visibility.
surfaces.focus: Popover requests details focus; Find interactions do not force it closed; Escape returns to toggle in native recheck.
surfaces.motion: Top-inset transition and popup lifecycle; no arbitrary drag/resize/minimize contract established.
surfaces.lifetime: Popup stays in tree across mode changes to close cleanly; details state is not workspace active-tab state.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Overview has related information inside the tool workspace.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Overview tab, narrower forced panel width, or copied card styling alone cannot coexist equivalently with a loaded tool.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Previously named toggle/lineage but independent presentation omitted.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Confirmed quality-correction-005, already added by parent; do not double-count.
surfaces.native_evidence: Dedicated recheck verified toggle, shortcut, focus, Escape and one fallback. Subsequent parent-owned native evidence verified Thread details beside loaded README with an intact draft; all-tool and narrow-screen variants remain open. See ../evidence/surface-reconciliation/observations.md.

surfaces.name: Lineage and Side chats sections inside details
surfaces.purpose: Show parent/child/fork/transfer relations and related side conversations.
surfaces.placement: Conditional sections inside full-density details card; not entire details host.
surfaces.triggers: Existing related/active/previous/remote rows or side chats; visibility customization.
surfaces.coexistence: Workspace/Git/usage/context sections share card; inline agent group remains in transcript.
surfaces.responsive: Only full density mounts these sections; pagination limits visible lineage rows.
surfaces.ownership: Graph distinguishes subagent, fork, transfer, sideChat and linked-environment relations.
surfaces.focus: Ordinary children navigate full route; side-chat predicate opens side tab; tooltip carries details.
surfaces.motion: Group disclosure state; no new native transition guarantee asserted.
surfaces.lifetime: Active/previous grouping is status-derived and detail may load after navigation.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Subject ancestry data exists; main drill and compact rendering lose some navigation.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A flat named-agent list cannot replace immediate-parent/root ancestry or distinguish side-chat destination.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Original source coverage exists; card density/coexistence integration was omitted.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Correct placement and status scope jointly; do not claim provider children are ordinary left-sidebar rows.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native parent/child label disagreement observed; not child loss.

surfaces.name: Antigravity-native Subagent work dialog
surfaces.purpose: Read provider-native child records that are not independently messageable.
surfaces.placement: Modal dialog launched from provider-child footer only for selected antigravity driver.
surfaces.triggers: Subagent work button; query starts only while open.
surfaces.coexistence: Overlays child conversation; never substitutes for Sol/Sonnet normal route.
surfaces.responsive: max-w-2xl popup; footer label can be screen-reader-only at narrow composer width.
surfaces.ownership: nativeChildWork query keyed by environment/thread; refresh, loading/error/empty/truncation states.
surfaces.focus: Shared dialog primitive controls focus/Close; read-only child steps, no messaging input.
surfaces.motion: Shared dialog 200ms source styles; no native timing measurement.
surfaces.lifetime: Local open state; content/query unmounts when closed.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Provider-scoped history/coverage messaging exists; no exact Antigravity dialog counterpart established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Compact Agent panel is not justification to replace normal child routes with a read-only modal for all providers.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Already covered and provider-qualified in source; not a newly discovered missing feature.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Audit still needs branch-specific execution if this optional provider is adopted.
surfaces.native_evidence: Antigravity dialog was not executed in native audit.

surfaces.name: Draft hero and ordinary composer host
surfaces.purpose: Compose new conversation or next message while retaining transcript reading space.
surfaces.placement: Centered headline/composer for empty draft; bottom overlay for active thread.
surfaces.triggers: Draft hero predicate, project selection, transition toward first send.
surfaces.coexistence: Banners detach below hero but join active composer; branch/environment strip below host.
surfaces.responsive: Short-height media rule pins hero toward bottom; mobile composer can collapse to prompt summary.
surfaces.ownership: Draft/session binding separate from existing thread and queued-edit target.
surfaces.focus: Typed editor owns IME; focus restoration and mobile expansion are distinct from panel focus.
surfaces.motion: Draft hero/view-transition names and composer background transitions exist; no native interpolation measured here.
surfaces.lifetime: Composer may stay mounted across threads; provider-child branch unmounts it entirely.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native composer region and draft binding.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: An always-visible generic input or child footer cannot stand in for all draft/running/question states.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Draft persistence and input mechanics covered; centered/overlay/mobile assembly not systematically retained.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Presentation/lifetime coverage gap, not newly reproduced loss.
surfaces.native_evidence: Existing-draft and combined content flows observed; mobile/first-send animation unexecuted.

surfaces.name: Composer model, effort, permissions and primary actions
surfaces.purpose: Show provider settings and the actual send/steer/queue/stop/resume action.
surfaces.placement: Footer or resting controls host within composer, plus optional context strip.
surfaces.triggers: Measured room, focus/resting state, active turn, pending question, nonempty draft.
surfaces.coexistence: Does not replace question drawer or inline approval details; control relocation must preserve identity.
surfaces.responsive: Controls can hide blocks/use icons; mobile pending answers move primary actions inside editor area.
surfaces.ownership: Selected model and effective runtime policy; Stop key belongs to thread, not reused composer instance.
surfaces.focus: Model picker and permission menus have explicit open state; pointer-focus preservation varies by viewport.
surfaces.motion: Source hover/background transitions; stop pending state is functional feedback.
surfaces.lifetime: Footer action keyed by environment/thread; resumed route cannot reuse old stop state.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Model/effort/permission chips, native primary actions.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Showing one Stop icon does not certify queue timing, question submission or effective sandbox truth.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Source and bounded actual provider setting/Stop checks covered.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Require relocation/focus and action-state matrix rather than a single screenshot.
surfaces.native_evidence: Sol Stop, Sonnet Stop/Resume verified; Sol Resume and held queue not executed.

surfaces.name: Command, entity and prompt-stash overlays
surfaces.purpose: Select commands/context or restore independent stashed drafts.
surfaces.placement: Anchored menu above composer body.
surfaces.triggers: Typed trigger or stash badge; stash only when command menu is closed.
surfaces.coexistence: Menu and stash are mutually selected; ordinary draft remains separate from chosen context.
surfaces.responsive: Anchor and popup width govern narrow layout; no desktop screenshot establishes mobile behavior.
surfaces.ownership: Draft context records and selected provider catalogs; stash queue has independent entries.
surfaces.focus: Editor active suggestion ID and highlighted item coordinate keyboard navigation.
surfaces.motion: Menu layer/popover motion comes from primitives; native motion unmeasured.
surfaces.lifetime: Menus are ephemeral; stashes are draft records, not sent queue runs.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native command/file/skill menus; independent prompt stash not established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Queued message editing or prompt history is not a stash menu with independent draft/context entries.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Feature differences covered; overlay collision/focus not fully exercised.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Retain mutual-exclusion and outside/Escape behavior as explicit acceptance.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native command/entity/stash authoring variants not certified by the combined send run.

surfaces.name: Assistant selection Cite toolbar
surfaces.purpose: Capture a selected passage with source identity.
surfaces.placement: Portal near selection, clamped inside browser window.
surfaces.triggers: Valid assistant selection and citation callback; keyboard focus shortcut.
surfaces.coexistence: Can sit above transcript while composer stays mounted; source selection is not whole-response Reply.
surfaces.responsive: Window clamp prevents toolbar overflow; max selected length can disable citing.
surfaces.ownership: Selected thread/message/range and source anchor.
surfaces.focus: Pointer down preserves selection; keyboard can focus toolbar; callback inserts into owning composer.
surfaces.motion: No toolbar entrance interpolation was established from inspected code.
surfaces.lifetime: Selection observer/portal disappears with selection or source lifecycle.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native floating Cite selection action creates Reply text.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: General response context menu or quoted text alone does not preserve selected-source identity.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Selection behavior covered; whole-response Reply is newer-only and remains qualified.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: No new absence; keep precise insertion owner and selection/focus contract.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native selection and Cite worked with markers.

surfaces.name: Citation chip comment editor and sent source card
surfaces.purpose: Author, reopen and cancel per-quote comments; return from sent quote to source.
surfaces.placement: Anchored comment popover in draft; source link plus comment in sent user row.
surfaces.triggers: Cite insertion or comment edit action; sent card activation navigates.
surfaces.coexistence: Ordinary prompt and images coexist; comment draft differs from saved comment.
surfaces.responsive: Popover and multiline editor bound to source; full comment whitespace preserved in sent card.
surfaces.ownership: Citation schema stores environment/thread/message/text/context/comment; source navigation is explicit.
surfaces.focus: Textarea supports multiline, Save/Cancel and submit-and-send; focus return tied to chip/source.
surfaces.motion: Shared popup transitions; no native animation timing claim.
surfaces.lifetime: Uncommitted comment draft clears on close; source observation detects disappearance; sent citation remains.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Reply stores quote/text but UI has no per-quote authoring path and no navigable source identity.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Ordinary composer commentary is not an editable comment associated with a citation.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Known comment/provenance gaps source-backed; actual combined T3 delivery verified.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Keep comment, quote disclosure and source navigation as separate contracts.
surfaces.native_evidence: Save/reopen/cancel, combined send and source return verified; transient highlight not established.

surfaces.name: Structured context chips and details popovers
surfaces.purpose: Inspect terminal, review, preview annotation, thread, machine, image or file context without leaving draft.
surfaces.placement: Inline chips in editor; some open top-side details popover, others preview media or navigate.
surfaces.triggers: Record kind decides renderer and action; unresolved record gets explicit fallback.
surfaces.coexistence: Review diff or annotation crop detail can coexist with composer and workspace.
surfaces.responsive: Chip truncation is paired with detail presentation; popover width bounded by shared primitive.
surfaces.ownership: Draft context records keep typed identities; unavailable record is not silently substituted.
surfaces.focus: Accessible Show details trigger; separate remove/action buttons and source-aware context callbacks.
surfaces.motion: Shared popup transition and chip hover underline; source-only timing.
surfaces.lifetime: Popover ephemeral; records persist with draft and bind outgoing attachment IDs.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Attachment shelf, review count, browser annotations and path tokens.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: An 88px tile, count-only chip or raw filename is not complete inspectable structured context.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Capabilities covered in slices; per-kind opener/destination assembly was not reconciled.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Important inspection/ownership audit gap; no blanket Ferrite absence asserted for every kind.
surfaces.native_evidence: Preview annotation detail and actual provider receipt observed; all other record kinds not certified.

surfaces.name: Draft attachment strip and file preview dialog
surfaces.purpose: Show attachment readiness, thumbnail, retry/removal and full file preview.
surfaces.placement: Media row/file list above editor; non-image preview is a modal dialog.
surfaces.triggers: Attach/paste/drop; media preview or filename activation.
surfaces.coexistence: Does not consume workspace active tab just to inspect unsent file.
surfaces.responsive: Media absent when mobile collapsed; separate resting thumbnails; dialog width/height bounded.
surfaces.ownership: Attachment draft target, upload/preparation state, nonpersisted warnings.
surfaces.focus: Named Preview/Remove/Retry controls; file dialog Close retains draft.
surfaces.motion: Snapshot frame opacity/scale with reduced-motion classes; ordinary image row is not proven animated.
surfaces.lifetime: Preview file ID is local; removing/closing affects preview/draft separately.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native attachment tiles and file/image preview destinations exist.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Path pasted into text or sent-file workspace tab is not unsent attachment readiness and inspection.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Readiness and clipping source issues known; file chooser runtime limited.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Need classify preview route per draft type rather than call all previews equivalent.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native T3 PNG attach/remove affordance/preview verified; Ferrite file intake not exercised by prior controlled correction.

surfaces.name: Expanded image/video dialog
surfaces.purpose: Inspect media from draft, history or tool output at usable size.
surfaces.placement: Media modal above other composer/popover overlays.
surfaces.triggers: onImageExpand or attachment/media chip preview.
surfaces.coexistence: Underlying draft and workspace retain state; nested context menu owns Escape before dialog.
surfaces.responsive: 92vw/92vh media frame and zoom/pan; not mobile bottom-sheet variant.
surfaces.ownership: Atom carries owning threadKey and preview; owned blob URL revoked when replaced.
surfaces.focus: Initial Close focus; explicit saved opener restoration after unmount; arrows navigate/pan with context-menu guard.
surfaces.motion: Shared media dialog opacity/scale 200ms source styles; no measured runtime smoothness.
surfaces.lifetime: Leaving route clears preview through thread-overlay registry; close clears atom.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native Preview host handles images; complete equivalent media modal/focus contract not established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Opening a generic reader or workspace image tab is not proof of equivalent modal nesting and focus return.
surfaces.prior_coverage: PNG dialog visible and Escape worked; full image-dialog lifetime was not explicitly mapped.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Source-level focus and route-scoping gap in previous reconciliation.
surfaces.native_evidence: T3 filename/100% preview and draft preservation verified; multi-image/video cases untested.

surfaces.name: Queued messages and transactional edit target
surfaces.purpose: Inspect pending future inputs and edit/promote/remove each by stable identity.
surfaces.placement: Timeline end after current state and pending guest rows; editing uses composer.
surfaces.triggers: Queued run or uncommitted optimistic queued message.
surfaces.coexistence: Working state and queue both visible; unrelated main draft preserved by separate edit target.
surfaces.responsive: Visible queue count limited with Show more; row actions wrap independently.
surfaces.ownership: Run/message identity and separate queued-edit draft target.
surfaces.focus: Edit/Cancel/Save/Send now have explicit callbacks; saving makes composer host inert/aria-busy.
surfaces.motion: No queue transition claim; source command success determines lifecycle.
surfaces.lifetime: Optimistic rows disappear after committed; save clears only successful edit target.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Queue cards/actions exist, but Edit cancels/takes back and merges draft.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Prompt history, native steer queue or stash cannot substitute for transactional queued editing and timing intent.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Known composer-04/05; controlled runtime plus real T3 one-item save.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Do not treat queue-card presence as cancellation/race/draft-isolation coverage.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native T3 queue/edit/promote receipt passed; multi-item order/cancel/race not certified.

surfaces.name: Ordinary pending approval inside timeline
surfaces.purpose: Show exact proposed action and decision choices where it belongs in work history.
surfaces.placement: Inline WorkLogRow; unmatched approvals appended at transcript list end.
surfaces.triggers: Pending approval projection not held by typing guard.
surfaces.coexistence: Composer remains for decline/redirect feedback; approval details and More options are separate.
surfaces.responsive: Command text scrolls up to bounded height; actions wrap.
surfaces.ownership: Request ID and live response capability; vanished provider cannot be approved.
surfaces.focus: Command is selectable; buttons and More options route the exact request; typing feedback has approval-specific meaning.
surfaces.motion: Button pending feedback is distinct from generic loading; no native timing measurement.
surfaces.lifetime: Pending row changes to settled history through provider events; response state prevents duplicate decisions.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Decision cards rendered in transcript tail; exact approval answer path shared.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A generic waiting badge or main-composer send must not approve an unrelated child.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Bounded approvals covered; assembly with held typing/feedback and exact action not fully exercised.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Action ownership and coexistence need explicit matrix, not new blanket missing approval claim.
surfaces.native_evidence: Real Sonnet separate command/edit/test approvals observed; final model claim of no approvals rejected.

surfaces.name: Related-child approval stack above composer
surfaces.purpose: Answer exact child-thread approvals without losing owning root context.
surfaces.placement: Separate scrollable stack immediately above composer shell.
surfaces.triggers: childThreadApprovalsAtom returns related approvals.
surfaces.coexistence: Distinct from active thread pending approval row and child read-only footer.
surfaces.responsive: max-h-80 scroll stack; per-card command max-h-40.
surfaces.ownership: Environment/thread/request triple keys cards; command submits entry.thread.threadId.
surfaces.focus: Per-card button disabled on missing operation scope or nonlive capability; card-level error is visible.
surfaces.motion: No stack entrance animation established.
surfaces.lifetime: Cards follow pending atom; local responding/error state keyed by exact request triple.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Core pending decisions retain Subject; compact drill omits Decision strip.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Generic Open thread selecting first pending child is not an exact named-child request route.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Child decision gaps known; separate T3 stack was not prominent in prior inventory.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Assembly/ownership omission; not proof that native Sonnet observed this exact component rather than parent-owned request row.
surfaces.native_evidence: Sonnet child command appeared in parent; source component reachability not uniquely established by that screenshot.

surfaces.name: Pending question drawer and answer mode
surfaces.purpose: Present questions, choice options and custom answer with request-scoped submission.
surfaces.placement: Attached drawer above editor; editor becomes custom-answer field, primary actions become question actions.
surfaces.triggers: Pending user-input request; multiquestion progress controls current question.
surfaces.coexistence: Open question suppresses unrelated attention banners, retaining machine problems; attachments capability-gated.
surfaces.responsive: Collapsible drawer and mobile inline action relocation; option text wraps.
surfaces.ownership: Answers/questionIndex belong to runtime request, not ordinary draft text.
surfaces.focus: Digit shortcuts ignore editor contexts; single-choice can auto-advance; IME guard and required answer state matter.
surfaces.motion: Collapsible and option-state CSS exist; no native multiquestion timing guarantee.
surfaces.lifetime: Auto-advance timer cancels on request change/disable/unmount; ordinary draft must survive request lifecycle.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Native request forms/choices exist; controlled field clicks routed to composer in bounded replay.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: An ordinary composer or approval card is not a form with field validation and custom-answer ownership.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Known form/focus uncertainty remains; one T3 single choice passed.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Need question/composer arbitration and editor-focused number shortcut as explicit boundaries.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native Cobalt single-choice receipt verified; typing 2 in focused field inserted text rather than choosing option.

surfaces.name: Timeline present-state, pending handoff and guest proposal rows
surfaces.purpose: Show current attention/work/sync/goal, lifecycle and proposed next input at the end of conversation.
surfaces.placement: Timeline footer, before queued own messages.
surfaces.triggers: attentionNow/workNow/goalNow/sync, handoff, status line, guest or queued count.
surfaces.coexistence: Independent of top error lane and composer sending banners; Scroll to end summary can show child input/queue count.
surfaces.responsive: NoticeText truncates with details popover while actions remain reachable; touch targets expand.
surfaces.ownership: Selected thread; related-child open action names destination; guest send/dismiss are explicit.
surfaces.focus: Attention uses alert semantics, sync status; details popover exposes cut text, actions remain focusable.
surfaces.motion: ThreadNow source has 150ms fade and reduced-motion opt-out.
surfaces.lifetime: Footer mounted only while one present/queued condition exists; guest additions follow only if reader was already following.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Background-work footer line exists; Background panel uses separate inventory.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Persistent Background tab, top error toast or composer shelf is not same current-state position and reader-follow contract.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Background and guest capability source coverage exist; combined footer ordering/coexistence was not audited as one composition.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Require current-state/queue visibility and named request destinations; optional guest runtime remains unexecuted.
surfaces.native_evidence: Normal working/waiting/Stopped observed; guest/handoff/goal branches not native certified.

surfaces.name: Composer sending notices and top error lane
surfaces.purpose: Separate provider/thread faults from sending-context notices and machine attention.
surfaces.placement: Provider/thread glass alerts at top of canvas; attached composer notice cards or detached below hero.
surfaces.triggers: Provider setup/error, thread failure; fallback, usage, clone, extension, fresh session, branch or environment item.
surfaces.coexistence: Question drawer can replace attention notices while machine warning/error remains; top lane independent.
surfaces.responsive: Overflow NoticeText opens details; card action rows wrap; hero short-height rule places banners in flow.
surfaces.ownership: Provider banner uses selected instance; thread error dismissal has own key/session state; composer items have stable IDs/order.
surfaces.focus: Refresh provider, setup, expand error and dismiss have separate controls; no focus theft by generic notification inferred.
surfaces.motion: Composer stack fades 150ms with reduced-motion; top alert source does not prove equivalent motion.
surfaces.lifetime: Ready/dismissed provider suppresses banner; pending refresh state settles independently of thread activity.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Session errors/notices and composer error fields exist; exact two-lane equivalence not established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: One generic red message/toast cannot replace provider-refresh, thread fault and draft-specific actions.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Provider banner real refresh observed; whole channel hierarchy previously fragmented across reports.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Important composition gap; source conditions must be exercised without overwriting draft or hiding recovery.
surfaces.native_evidence: Codex probe timeout banner and visible recovery observed; root cause not diagnosed.

surfaces.name: Plan, rendered HTML and MCP app artifact viewers
surfaces.purpose: Read structured assistant artifacts and interact with their dedicated viewers.
surfaces.placement: Plan card, HTML frame or MCP app iframe inline; HTML media dialog or MCP fullscreen on demand.
surfaces.triggers: proposed-plan/html-render/mcp-app row kinds.
surfaces.coexistence: Fullscreen preserves inline height or pins parent state; unrelated tool panel remains distinct.
surfaces.responsive: Plan content can collapse; HTML dialog caps viewport; MCP iframe changes display mode while preserving row height.
surfaces.ownership: Plan save is workspace write with explicit form; HTML blob/fullscreen lifetime belongs viewer; MCP host scoped to app.
surfaces.focus: Plan action menu/save form, HTML expand/Close/zoom, MCP iframe interaction have separate focus contexts.
surfaces.motion: HTML hover controls and shared modal styles exist; no MCP/native animation claim.
surfaces.lifetime: HTML expansion releases fullscreen pin on unmount; closed MCP app shows recoverable closed state.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Markdown/code/Mermaid exist; direct full artifact viewer equivalence not established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Code fence, rendered file preview or embedded browser tab is not an interactive MCP app or artifact viewer.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Markdown/media known; installed in-chat HTML/MCP modal composition not systematically reconciled.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Actual audit coverage omission, source-only; product adoption decision needed before counting as Ferrite defects.
surfaces.native_evidence: No native plan-save, HTML expand or MCP app execution was performed.

surfaces.name: Secret and machine-link request cards
surfaces.purpose: Resolve secret or machine-link requests in their dedicated UI.
surfaces.placement: Secret inline form; link inline request launches multistep modal wizard.
surfaces.triggers: secret_request or link_request item; display can become answered or pending elsewhere.
surfaces.coexistence: Separate from normal approval/question drawer and generic provider setup settings.
surfaces.responsive: Forms wrap within message lane; link wizard uses shared modal presentation.
surfaces.ownership: Request IDs and active owner; secrets use dedicated source/input rather than prompt transcript text.
surfaces.focus: Own form validation/submit/cancel; link wizard machine/access steps and failure state.
surfaces.motion: Shared modal styles for link flow; secret form motion not established.
surfaces.lifetime: Answered/pending-elsewhere renders compact row; in-flight buttons disabled.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: General approval/elicitation machinery exists; no exact secret/link workflow counterpart established.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Settings secret provider entry or MCP reconnect control is not in-conversation request resolution.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Settings capabilities named; these installed conversation branches were not explicitly mapped.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Actual surface inventory omission; source-only and optional, not a new runtime failure.
surfaces.native_evidence: Neither branch was executed; no credentials or remote access changed.

surfaces.name: Embedded Side chat conversation and Bring back
surfaces.purpose: Explore a fork beside parent, then defer its context into next parent input.
surfaces.placement: Tabbed workspace side pane with own title/Bring back/Delete/Close and embedded ChatView.
surfaces.triggers: Add Side chat or context action; finished side reply enables merge candidate.
surfaces.coexistence: Parent main conversation and side composer coexist; embedded view suppresses main header/details/workspace/drawer siblings.
surfaces.responsive: Width is outer workspace contract; body reuses conversation lane/mobile rules.
surfaces.ownership: Side thread differs from provider child; readSettings copies model/mode; merge records pending context transfer.
surfaces.focus: ComposerHandleContext reset isolates input owner; Bring back is a deferred operation, not auto-submit.
surfaces.motion: No side-body interpolation proven; outer panel lifecycle belongs workspace map.
surfaces.lifetime: Installed close requests delete onlyIfUnused, so a side chat with a run/message survives; explicit Delete is separate. Ferrite surface release removes the side tab and retires its backing thread. Native T3 reopened sent contents; restart/unsent-draft behavior remains unverified.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Side chat and Bring back exist; Ferrite inserts serialized quote into parent draft instead of installed pending transfer design.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: A provider-child Agent panel or read-only compact transcript cannot replace independently editable Side chat.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Real deferred receipt now verified; Ferrite controlled reopen failure known.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Keep main-child and side-pane authoring separate. Ferrite close/delete conflation is source-supported; the existing controlled blank reopen is runtime evidence, not a new native reproduction.
surfaces.native_evidence: Actual inherited Sol context, next-parent receipt without sentinel supplied, and closed/reopened sent contents verified.

surfaces.name: Thread-scoped confirmation and setup hosts
surfaces.purpose: Confirm rewind/branch effects or start PR/device setup at the originating thread.
surfaces.placement: Modal/alert-dialog hosts, not part of transcript rows or workspace tab body.
surfaces.triggers: Revert/Edit from here, restore branch, PR-thread action, device setup, Link PR.
surfaces.coexistence: Underlying chat can become inert while reverting; embedded mode suppresses most global setup hosts.
surfaces.responsive: Shared dialog mobile sheet/max-height defaults; each host owns its content limits.
surfaces.ownership: Overlay atoms carry threadKey; leaving route closes stale entries; handlers bind operation destination.
surfaces.focus: Dialog actions/cancel and shared primitive focus; no write is implied by merely opening dialog.
surfaces.motion: Retained popup children support exit; source default 200ms opacity/scale, no runtime smoothness certified.
surfaces.lifetime: Revert and image hosts remain independent; branch/PR/device/link hosts have embedded suppression.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Rewind/fork and operation confirmation paths exist; exact per-host equivalence not established here.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: One generic confirmation popup or panel tab does not prove correct thread ownership across route changes.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Individual capabilities inspected; common overlay thread-lifetime contract was not captured.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Assembly/lifetime coverage omission; workspace and shell specialists own detailed tool dialogs.
surfaces.native_evidence: PR actions inspected without remote writes; these destructive/remote confirmations were not executed.

surfaces.name: Canvas preview, bottom terminal drawer and workspace siblings
surfaces.purpose: Keep preview/tool work independently hosted beside the conversation.
surfaces.placement: ThreadPreviewMiniPlayer inside canvas; ChatTerminalDrawers below column; ChatRightPanel beside column.
surfaces.triggers: Preview state, terminal toggle, workspace surfaces and maximize.
surfaces.coexistence: Details card is independent; maximized workspace explicitly makes chat inert; embedded side chat does not recursively mount workspace.
surfaces.responsive: Inline/sheet/float/terminal-drawer are separate presentation contracts, delegated to workspace report.
surfaces.ownership: Active threadKey and workspace store; preview session sync gated by capabilities and nonembedded route.
surfaces.focus: Separate focus scopes; hidden/maximized chat inert prevents accidental input.
surfaces.motion: Panel duration passed explicitly; no claim that default 0ms yields animation.
surfaces.lifetime: Presence retention and outer surface close/reopen owned by workspace reconciliation.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: Ferrite Panel and terminal/browser/file surfaces exist.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Thread details card, floating browser preview, terminal drawer and workspace tab are not interchangeable names.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Source reports existed but header/card/tool spatial distinction caused actual omissions.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: Conversation map records sibling boundary; full outer tool contract is delegated, not omitted.
surfaces.native_evidence: Native browser/tool/terminal runs and one details coexistence recheck recorded by parent.

surfaces.name: Voice recording and transcription state
surfaces.purpose: Record, review and cancel spoken input without accidental send.
surfaces.placement: Recording pill/button and live transcription inside composer; setup overlay when required.
surfaces.triggers: Speech capability/settings and user record/setup actions.
surfaces.coexistence: Question/approval modes and frozen editor have special submission ownership.
surfaces.responsive: Resting/mobile composer may hide ordinary footer, but active voice keeps relevant controls visible.
surfaces.ownership: Transcription environment and request generation separate from normal keyboard draft.
surfaces.focus: Cancel/finish shortcuts, setup focus and frozen-editor state must retain original input.
surfaces.motion: No measured recording animation or meter timing; source controls only.
surfaces.lifetime: Recording/preparing/transcribing/setup state governs editor freeze and cleanup.
surfaces.ferrite_counterpart: No integrated voice UI established; OS dictation is a different path.
surfaces.wrong_substitute: Audio attachment or operating-system dictation is not recording/transcription/cancel state in composer.
surfaces.prior_coverage: Known optional voice gap; native audit observed Off and did not enable.
surfaces.actual_audit_omission: No new finding; explicit unexecuted conditional surface retained.
surfaces.native_evidence: Not executed; no microphone/model/integration started.
